payload.title: Prove repeated autonomous editorial cycles
payload.goal: Demonstrate observation through next decision twice with real correct-account receipts and independent review.
payload.owner_role: Windows combined release parent / admitted WHB lane
implementation_steps: Run labeled offline cycle and crash/owner-revision fixtures on exact reviewed source; archive pipeline lineage from factual source to publication version.

Under qualified zero-cash account grants, observe baseline, register an experiment, select/review/publish one excellent piece, verify actual public account/content/permalink and collect the declared measurement window.

Evaluate and autonomously choose the next justified experiment without a new launch prompt; complete and verify a second real receiving-system cycle, owner pause/resume and crash/restart. If evidence remains insufficient, persist bounded waiting with a next trigger. Waiting is a valid operational state, but runtime autonomy acceptance remains incomplete until the second real allowed cycle completes; audience/business validation is a separate evidence outcome.
tests: Two cycle traces connect observation -> decision -> registered reviewed action -> actual public receipt -> evaluation -> next decision.
Reviewer identity/model/source hash and verification independently match the published candidate; synthetic fixtures cannot satisfy real receipt acceptance.
Pause after approval and crash after post acceptance cause no duplicate or wrong-account post; idle periods consume zero inference.

review.identity_requirement: A reviewer other than the implementer records actual identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model review when required by the admitted contract. Self-review does not qualify.
review.source_binding: Review exact Git commit and SHA256 manifest of changed source/assets/config; distinguish Windows CRLF worktree bytes from Git blobs. Any repair invalidates affected prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two repair/review attempts per candidate within admitted budget; unresolved failure creates one actionable block and leaves independent work eligible.

acceptance: WHB runtime autonomy is demonstrated independently from content performance and growth.
Real audience growth/return interest is reported only from observed metrics, including inconclusive or negative results.
payload.rollback: Disable this capability, retain immutable evidence/receipts, restore the last reviewed source/config version and reconcile attempted external effects before any retry.
payload.next_eligible_action: Designated owner matches the proposed scope to current Jira/source and assigns disjoint paths; then perform implementation step 1. External gates block only the named effects.

estimate.assumptions: New planning estimate, not historical estimate or worklog. Reuse accepted returned implementation where its exact source passes this contract. Excludes elapsed observation windows, account waiting and shared SH implementation.
estimate.dependency_risk: Host/provider/account qualification or conflicting release-worker ownership can delay dependent effects; offline work remains eligible.
